text:
Ethan: Hey folks 1 I handed in my resignation today. Last day 2026-08-19. I'm on a work visa (H-1B) and want to confirm benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, and the visa sponsorship wrapup steps. Also need to coordinate final payroll for an international transfer.

Priya: Thanks for the heads-up, Ethan. Benefits run through your last day (2026-08-19 23:59 PT). COBRA notice will be emailed within ~10 business days and you have 60 days to enroll from that notice. For visa sponsorship, we'll start the offboard workflow to notify immigration counsel 1 they'll contact you about transfer/reciprocal filing and revoke sponsorship once paperwork is complete.

Ethan: Appreciate that. For payroll: Im paid in INR and will need a final run to my Indian bank. Any tax forms I need to complete for the final payout?

Payroll Bot: Final paycheck rules: last regular payroll runs per payroll schedule, plus accrued PTO paid out on the next payroll cycle. For international transfers, verify up-to-date bank and tax residency info in Workday by 2026-08-12 to ensure processing. If you worked abroad, complete the exit tax questionnaire: https://redwood.in/hr/intl-exit-tax.

Sofia: On visa process: immigration counsel requires access to your case docs so they can file any change-of-status or withdrawal forms. Priya, I'll coordinate. Ethan, please DM a copy of passport and I-94 to People Ops Secure Upload (do not post here).

Ethan: Will DM. Also have two service keys attached to my account (ci-deploy and metrics-publish). I need to hand them over; ci-deploy is required by the new owner for scheduled releases.

IT Ops: We can do a staged rotation. Please list service key IDs; we'll schedule rotation windows to handover without breaking releases. Quick command to list keys: 

```
redwood-cli keys list --owner ethan --format json
```

Priya: Suggested timeline: 1) final KT week of 2026-08-12 (3x 1hr sessions), 2) staged service key rotation on 2026-08-20 (post-last-day) during a 4hr maintenance window, 3) immigration counsel confirmation email by 2026-08-22. Does that work?

Ethan: KT week ok. Can we request building access extended 48h after last day for in-person handoff? Ill be returning the laptop via HQ mailroom. Also need a shipping label to send home a small external HDD.

Priya: We can request a 48h exception for building and SSO access for documentation only 1 please confirm exact times you need so IT can approve. We'll provide a prepaid shipping label for the HDD.

IT Ops: Extension approved tentatively until 2026-08-21 18:00 PT for SSO and keycard. Note: API keys are rotated on deprovision unless explicitly scheduled. Please mark ci-deploy for handover; metrics-publish should be rotated immediately after you've validated the new key.

Ethan: Marking ci-deploy as "handover" and leaving rotation steps in the Confluence runbook. I posted a short Loom of the release process: https://loom.com/share/ethan-release-brief.

Payroll Bot: Reminder: complete international tax exit questionnaire and confirm bank details by 2026-08-12 to avoid payment delays. If final payout requires currency conversion, fees may apply 1 Payroll will email fee estimates after you confirm your bank.

Sofia: Exit interview options: 2026-08-24 morning or 2026-08-25 afternoon. Also, because you're on visa, we'll include immigration counsel on a short wrap meeting to ensure no loose ends.

Ethan: Prefer 8/24 morning. Also, FYI: vesting cliff question 1 will unvested options be accelerated? Not urgent but want to confirm next steps.

Priya: Vesting follows the equity plan 1 unvested options are not accelerated by default. People Ops will include a summary in your offboard packet and provide contact for equity team if you want to discuss exceptions.

IT Ops: One more ask: run this to list active service sessions/dev machines you own so we can reassign before key rotation: 

```
redwood-cli sessions list --owner ethan --active
```

Ethan: Running inventory now and will paste results into the runbook. Thanks for the flexible timeline. Appreciate the support.

HR Bot: COBRA notice queued to ethan@redwood.com within 10 business days. COBRA enrollment window: 60 days from notice. Benefits termination: 2026-08-19 23:59 PT. Offboard doc: https://hr.redwood.com/offboard/3219876543.

Priya: I'll create the offboard task, attach immigration counsel contact, and add shipping label instructions. If anything sensitive comes up, we'll move to DM. :white_check_mark:
